:::{#def-bilinear-form}
#### Bilinear form

The **bilinear form** of a $p \times p$ [matrix](linear-algebra-matrices.qmd#def-matrix) $\matr{A}$
[@wikipedia_bilinear_form]
is the function that [maps](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) each pair of vectors $\vx, \vy \in \reals^p$
to the [scalar](linear-algebra-vectors.qmd#def-scalar)

$$
\bform{\matr{A}}{\vx}{\vy} \eqdef \tp{\vx}\, \matr{A}\, \vy.
$$

:::
